build_DenseNet_MLP: build a feed forward MLP network using DenseNet with configurable layers and leaky_relu activation
build_Conv2DNet: build a 2D convolutional network using Conv2DNet with optional batch normalization and configurable strides
build_SpatialConvEncoder: build a spatial convolutional encoder using SpatialConvEncoder to learn Hamiltonian latent representations with diagonal normal distributions
build_SpatialConvDecoder: build a spatial convolutional decoder using SpatialConvDecoder to reconstruct observations from Hamiltonian latent space
build_flexible_recurrent_net: build a flexible recurrent network using make_flexible_recurrent_net with LSTM, GRU, or VanillaRNN cores
